svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "A sample of 100 unstable nuclei (yellow). Each one decays at random (turns grey)."], [1, "Watch the count: after one half-life about half remain\u2026"], [4.0, "After one half-life: about 50 left."], [7.0, "After two half-lives: about 25 left (a quarter)."], [10.0, "After three half-lives: about 12 left (an eighth). The curve never quite reaches zero."]]
svg.title: Radioactive decay and half-life
svg.desc: One hundred nuclei decay at random while a decay curve is drawn; the number left halves every half-life: 100, 50, 25, 12.5.
svg.text: Random decay of 100 nuclei. N = N₀ × (½)^(t / T½).

g.data-info: Each nucleus has the same chance of decaying in a given time; which one decays next is random.
The number of undecayed nuclei (or the activity) halves in every half-life: an exponential decay curve.
The time for half the undecayed nuclei in a sample to decay (or for the activity to halve). It is constant for a given isotope.
